content_of_post_to_comment:
There is a lot of things i want to do, such as drawing, 3d modeling, writing, journaling, walking, even watching a tv show or playing video games. But almost every day, i end up resorting back to doomscrolling on youtube trying to find a video to watch instead of doing the things i want to do. Every time i try to start something, i get super resistant and overthink on the thing i want to do. Then id say “I’ll do it tomorrow“ then beat myself up for not doing it for the rest of the day.

Before anyone asks, yes i have ADHD and even OCD, and I’m really struggling with it. I need help with this, I don’t want to live my life just doom scrolling Youtube.
comment: I’ve noticed that when a hobby starts feeling like a “project” (especially with ADHD), the brain can treat it like a chore before you even begin. Sometimes lowering the entry point helps: draw one bad sketch, write three sentences, walk for five minutes. The goal is to rebuild starting, not finish something impressive.
